content.value: A six-pulse HVDC converter is connected to 330 kV AC grid using a 330 kV/220 (10) kV, 800 MVA, X<sub>t</sub> = 12% transformer. Determine the commutation overlap angle if the converter is operating at 20° firing angle and an 1800 A DC current.
